holdout_policy: Freeze before training; never use test answers or test outcomes for checkpoint selection. Changes after inspection require a new unseen test set.

metrics.false_fixes: applied candidates rejected by real program verification, excluding infrastructure interruptions
metrics.tokens_per_verified_repair: all evaluation input+output tokens, including failed attempts, divided by verified repairs; null when zero or usage missing
metrics.latency: record inference, verification and end-to-end separately; report each case and median; setup/training/deployment separate
metrics.unknown: report separately, never convert infrastructure errors into successes or program failures

promotion: A tuned response never bypasses strict patch application, protected-file checks or real execution verification.
